words.prose: {{ar:فَصِيلَتِهِ}} ({{tr:faṣīlatihi}}) names the criminal's own clan segment, not generic peoplehood. Its genitive case still depends on the earlier ransom frame, and the attached suffix keeps the same singular person moving through the possessive kinship chain, making this group specifically his. The feminine singular noun compresses a whole protective network into one ransomable object, larger than one brother but still narrower than the following all-human expansion; then the following relative clause makes that same object the sheltering agent. Lexically, the local sense is the near-kin branch of {{ar:ف ص ل}} ({{tr:f-ṣ-l}}), but the wider separation family remains audible: the closest social bond is named through a root that also speaks of cutting apart, weaning, decision, and detailing. That pressure must be kept narrow; it does not replace the local clan sense, but it makes the marked, rare concrete noun feel already shadowed by severance. The final -īhi of the clan noun is later answered by the shelter verb's ending, so belonging and refuge close around the same person in sound as well as grammar.

words.prose: {{ar:تُـْٔوِيهِ}} ({{tr:tuʾwīhi}}) closes the ayah on shelter itself. The imperfect makes the clan's refuge habitual or defining, while Form IV and the attached object suffix make the clan the active provider and the criminal the one sheltered. The word therefore reverses the clan's surface role: in the ransom list it is something offered, but inside the relative clause it is the agent that used to contain him. The shelter image is protective enclosure rather than neutral residence, and the broader {{ar:أ و ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-w-y}}) field lets temporary human refuge brush against final abode language, including the Fire/Garden abode contrast (79:39-41), without making that broader abode sense the local verb meaning. The marked Form IV refuge frame also resonates with contested shelter scenes (11:43, 11:80, 15:70), though those scenes remain echoes rather than controls on this parse. Accepted recitational variants around the hamza and suffix change the sound contour while preserving the same shelter relation, and the phrase's paired -īhi endings make the same person audible first as possessor and then as object. A separate root dispute marks the hamzated surface as derivationally sensitive, but the local shelter frame still selects the refuge root.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun at word 1 names his near-kin segment, and the feminine relative clause anchored at word 3 predicates active sheltering by that segment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded inner kin-group gathers its member into a protective point; kinship is functional reception, not merely descent.

activation_trace.role: The near-kin clan segment supplies the bounded social unit that bears the sheltering relative clause.
Drawing someone into a sheltering gathering point makes that kin segment an active refuge.

changed_reading.after: His nearest clan segment, defined here by actively receiving and sheltering him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two lexical anchors at words 1 and 3 place separation and sheltering inside one relative construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun marks a subset off from the wider people, while the verb reverses dispersion by drawing the possessor inward. The boundary is therefore what enables inclusion.

activation_trace.role: Separation until a boundary appears supplies the distinct inside and outside of the kin unit.
Gathering into a sheltering point turns the separated subset into a mechanism of recollection.

changed_reading.before: A clan happens to shelter him.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately bounded near-group shelters precisely by drawing its member back across its boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The kin noun and transitive sheltering verb can describe social-affective protection as well as lodging.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nearest clan turns toward its member in pity, making refuge an act of tenderness, advocacy, and protective concern.

activation_trace.role: The close clan segment identifies the social body capable of protective concern.
Compassionate turning toward someone supplies an affective mode of shelter rather than a merely spatial one.

changed_reading.before: The clan gives him a place to stay.
changed_reading.after: The clan takes him under tender protection and turns toward him as one of its own.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, intimate bonds remain visible and near but cease to carry communication. The sheltering clause consequently reads as the normal function of a bond that the crisis has made inoperative, not as an available rescue.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan segment supplies the bond whose ordinary protective capacity is being tested.
Active gathering into refuge supplies the normal function that context suspends.
Mutual questioning supplies the reciprocal social channel that the verse explicitly negates.
Kin-nearness makes the failed exchange a collapse within intimate proximity rather than absence.
Literal seeing keeps the relatives perceptually present while their protective relation fails.

structural_cues: 70:10 negates one intimate's asking of another; 70:11 immediately says they are made to see one another.
The focus relative clause therefore sits inside a sequence of present but inoperative social bonds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated exchange, intimate proximity, and enforced sight; I infer that visibility without exchange suspends the sheltering function. A live alternative is that the clauses register separate failures rather than one disabled social channel.

changed_reading.before: His close clan can gather him into safety.
changed_reading.after: The clause recalls what his close clan normally does, precisely when recognition remains but refuge no longer operates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated list expands through descendants, household companionship, sibling bond, the near-clan segment, and finally everyone on earth. This locates the focus noun as the widest still-personal enclosure before kinship gives way to total humanity.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan segment supplies a distinct scale of kin membership rather than an undifferentiated family label.
The gathering refuge makes this scale the outer ring that still receives him personally.
Descent and lineage supply the first generational ring in the expansion.
Close companionship supplies the attached household ring.
Brotherhood and kinship supply the lateral blood relation immediately before the clan segment.
Completion without remainder expands the sequence beyond personal rings to all people on earth.

structural_cues: The governed coordination runs continuously from 70:11 through 70:14.
The focus item follows son, companion, and brother but precedes everyone on earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered kin terms and final totalization; I map that order as expanding concentric social distance. It may instead be rhetorical accumulation without a strict kinship topology, but the focus item still occupies a diagnostic penultimate position.

changed_reading.before: His clan is another family member in a list.
changed_reading.after: His clan is the penultimate personal ring: broader than household and sibling bonds, yet still an enclosure that knows and receives him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sheltered person attempts to reverse the direction of protection: he would place the shelterers in his stead so that he can escape by separation. The later replacement image turns that logic back on the would-be substituter, who is himself replaceable.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan unit identifies the people converted from protectors into proposed substitutes.
Inward sheltering supplies the direction that the ransom wish morally reverses.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the substitution governing the focus object.
Deliverance by separation makes his desired rescue an extraction of self from the gathered kin body.
One thing standing in another's place returns replacement agency against the group that imagined controlling it.

structural_cues: The wish to ransom in 70:11 governs the coordinated focus noun, and the rescue result closes in 70:14.
70:41 later makes the threatened population, rather than its chosen victims, the possible object of replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ransom, rescue by separation, and later replacement; I infer a reversal of substitutional agency. The live alternative is that 70:41 concerns collective succession only and does not answer the earlier private ransom logic directly.

changed_reading.before: The clan is the subject's protective inside.
changed_reading.after: The subject tries to push his protective inside outward as exchange material, only to be exposed later as the party who can be replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus depicts a human being drawn into a living enclosure; the later portrait depicts things gathered into a vessel and withheld. These are rival inward movements: hospitable containment preserves a person, while hoarding seals goods in and closes the hand.

activation_trace.role: The kin segment supplies the living enclosure against which object-hoarding is compared.
Drawing a person inward for shelter supplies the hospitable form of containment.
Gathering dispersed things into a collected mass supplies the hoard's inward motion.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the sealed material enclosure that contrasts with hosting a person.
Holding the hand back from giving turns containment into blocked outward circulation.

structural_cues: 70:17-18 couples turning away with gathering and containerizing.
70:19-21 generalizes the crisis into a human pattern of panic under harm and withholding under good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hosting, gathering, vessel-containment, and withholding; I infer an ethical contrast between whom or what one keeps inside. A live alternative is that the hoarder portrait is independent of the earlier kin refuge and that the near-sound of the two enclosure verbs carries no designed force.

changed_reading.before: Shelter is simply a benign inward movement.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes hospitable inwardness from hoarding: a person is received and protected, whereas possessions are sealed in and withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ethical sequence carries protection across the clan boundary: private wealth contains a fixed claim for requester and deprived, while trusts and covenants are kept so their holders remain secure. Refuge becomes enacted stewardship rather than inherited reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: A marked boundary supplies the near-kin inside that the later obligations cross.
Receiving someone into protection supplies the function generalized beyond blood membership.
A fixed obligatory due makes support a binding claim rather than optional clan favor.

summary.what_was_special: The focus itself couples separation with gathering: ف ص ل marks a boundary or segment while ء و ي draws inward to refuge. Context repeatedly changes which boundary gathers, whom it protects, and whether inwardness becomes shelter, hoard, or substitution.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The group that shelters is also defined by an earlier separation.** *Faṣīlatihi* activates **ف ص ل, B003, “offspring separated from mother or nursing,”** as the branch image behind a clan subdivision, while the relative clause makes that group the one that shelters him. I infer a social mechanism: a bounded segment becomes a protective container precisely by being distinguished from a larger whole. The ransom wish reverses that mechanism, cutting away the very segment that gathered him in. The ayah therefore emphasizes violated belonging, not merely another item in a kin list.

2. **Shelter is a boundary that judgment penetrates.** **ف ص ل, B001, “separating one thing from another,”** and **B007, “short wall below a city or fortress wall,”** are activated by *tuʾwīhi* and by the surah’s later boundary language of guarded openings and transgression (70:29–31). Exploratorily, I infer that the clan functions like an inner wall. The ayah then reads as the attempted sacrifice of one’s own protective perimeter after all barriers fail.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Guarded openings, trusts, and covenants in 70:29–34 made the clan’s shelter newly legible as a maintained boundary. The later list corrected a purely genealogical reading toward violated custody.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Restraint, Enclosure, and the Loss of an Exit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Holding can be ethical self-command, protective enclosure, coercive confinement, or pathological pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same holding operation moves from beautiful patience to stopper, wall, armor, shackle, sealed wound, and crookedly healed bone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coercive enclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A captive is fixed inside walls, armor, sheath, vessel, and shackle with no outlet.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: detention for execution or compelled oath `quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`; ordeal with no opening `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`; hand-to-neck shackle `quranic:root_000259:B008/m01`; enclosing vessel `quranic:root_001664:B002/m01`; covering defense `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; armor or shield `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; sword sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene assembles progressively tighter boundaries: wall, armor, sheath, vessel, then shackle. What begins as protection changes role under judgment; every enclosure becomes part of confinement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations that ordinarily shelter, love, and remain near are recoded as substitutable assets offered for one person's release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The family list becomes at once a household map, a surety system, a prisoner exchange, and a total inventory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The sheltering intimate network
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Affection and proximity bind child, spouse, sibling, clan, companion, and refuge into one protective network.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affectionate close relative `quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`; sonship and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; companionship and continual presence `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; preservation through companionship `quranic:root_000844:B002/m01`; grown son becoming companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; tether or inviolable bond `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`; near clan segment `quranic:root_001159:B009/m01`; sheltering convergence `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; merciful concern `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; blood-nearness `quranic:root_001212:B003/m01`; affection `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; loving alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The list is a functioning social architecture: love supplies motive, kinship supplies nearness, companionship supplies duration, the tether supplies obligation, clan supplies collective backing, and refuge supplies place. Ransom violates every role at once.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Speech seeks, calls, or demands a response, but the only effective answer is the event itself.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Petition, riddle, curse, legal claim, and cascading collapse become alternate forms of a summons that cannot be negotiated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The petitioner who is pushed away
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A needy claimant is repelled, delayed, and excluded rather than having the request discharged.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: socially rejected petitioner `quranic:root_000480:B007/m01`; procrastinated claim `quranic:root_000480:B008/m01`; request for need `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; need fulfilled `quranic:root_000661:B003/m01`; emphatic negation `quranic:root_001390:B001/m01`; excluding exception `quranic:root_001390:B002/m01`; remote isolated settlement `quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`; mercy toward one seeking shelter `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:1,10` سَائِل/يَسْأَل (`س ء ل`); `70:2` لَيْس، دَافِع، كَافِرِين (`ل ي س`, `د ف ع`, `ك ف ر`); `70:13` تُؤْوِيه (`ء و ي`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The no-repeller formula acquires a social underside: a petitioner is physically pushed aside, a claim is stalled, and negation closes the case. The opening asker and the later failure of intimates to ask are held together by the collapse of ordinary petition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Visibility, Bodily Evidence, and Inscribed Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What was estimated, hidden, or relationally ignored is made perceptible through sight, marks, seams, blood, and text.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual disclosure extends into mirror, banner, blood trace, stitched edge, textual division, and signature.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mark, division, and written closure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A matter is made legible by banner, articulated speech, textual segmentation, detail, and a final written mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visible standard `quranic:root_000531:B011/m01`; tongue that distinguishes matters `quranic:root_001159:B004/m01`; textual and metrical divisions `quranic:root_001159:B011/m01`; analytic detailing `quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`; grammatical separator `quranic:root_001159:B015/m01`; signature or marginal notation `quranic:root_001675:B011/m01`; projected voice `quranic:root_000239:B008/m01`; alphabetic letter `quranic:root_000045:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Judgment becomes an act of legibility. A standard points, a tongue distinguishes, divisions organize, detail discloses components, and a signature closes the record. The relatives listed in discrete sequence read like the articulated sections of the criminal's liability.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Gestation, Weaning, and the Severed Offspring Bond
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life is joined through mating and gestation, then differentiated through birth, weaning, and maturation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The family list expands into animal breeding, visible pregnancy, uterine tissue, milk-before-birth, weaning, and the adult child becoming a companion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Separation by weaning and maturation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The young is separated from the mother, then grows until it can stand beside the parent as a companion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: young camel separated from mother and milk `quranic:root_001159:B003/m01`; young livestock separated until compliant `quranic:root_001684:B015/m01`; son maturing into companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; offspring and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; small offshoots named as daughters or sons `quranic:root_000156:B008/m01`; food building flesh `quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`; formed bodily structure `quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Separation is normally developmental: the young leaves milk, grows flesh and structure, and becomes a companion. Ransom deforms that process by treating mature relational independence as permission to sever obligation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Cultivation, Cutting, and the Hoarded Harvest
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rain and soil produce covered growth that is cut, sorted, and gathered into post-harvest stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hoard resembles a crop economy whose seed-covering, irrigation, palm propagation, cutting, gleaning, drying, and piling have been detached from redistribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covering seed and governing water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Seed is covered, fruit remains sheathed, and irrigation is admitted through regulated barriers into protected catchments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sowing by covering seed `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; fruit sheath `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`; drawing irrigation water `quranic:root_000751:B001/m01`; flood-control barrier `quranic:root_000751:B007/m01`; water-holding ground `quranic:root_001675:B008/m01`; raised ground above flood `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; mountain watercourse `quranic:root_001159:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Productive enclosure differs from hoarding: soil covers seed to germinate, a sheath protects fruit, and a barrier releases only needed water. These regulated containers expose the moral defect of accumulation in `70:18`, which closes without a life-giving outlet.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Cultivation, Cutting, and the Hoarded Harvest
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rain and soil produce covered growth that is cut, sorted, and gathered into post-harvest stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hoard resembles a crop economy whose seed-covering, irrigation, palm propagation, cutting, gleaning, drying, and piling have been detached from redistribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cutting, gleaning, and piling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Mature growth is cut, residual dates are gleaned, palm stock is propagated, and food is amassed into an unmeasured pile.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting fruit and shearing `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`; dates left after harvest `quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`; seed-grown date palms of mixed kind `quranic:root_000259:B011/m01`; transplanted palm shoot `quranic:root_001159:B016/m01`; piled food sold without measure `quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`; gathered dates or grain `quranic:root_001136:B004/m01`; taking the whole stock `quranic:root_000751:B009/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Harvest separates crop from plant, then recovers leftovers and gathers them into a pile. The final “taking the whole stock” motif turns gleaning's residual economy into total appropriation, aligning the harvest scene tightly with the hoarder.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Sovereign Capacity, Crime, and Unaccepted Surety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A fixed penalty issues from effective dominion, distinguishes liability, and cannot be neutralized by private ownership or guarantee.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Divine title, royal rule, calibrated design, adjudication, criminal gain, surety, and retribution form one legal order.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Adjudication and criminal liability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An offense is identified, judgment separates truth from false claim, and retribution reaches completion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: decisive judgment `quranic:root_001159:B002/m01`; offense and criminality `quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`; gain that incurs responsibility `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; fixed obligation `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; severe judicial event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`; retributive equivalence `quranic:root_000840:B012/m01`; decreed outcome `quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Crime is linked to acquisition, then passed through decisive separation and equivalent requital. The falling event is thus a judgment that has moved from liability to execution, not an unclassified catastrophe.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Covering, Refuge, and Exposure to the Sky
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering can shelter, conceal, or dignify, but judgment removes the interval between a body and the exposed heavens.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Canopy, garment, fruit sheath, armor, tent, mountain pass, and high refuge all test distinct ways of being covered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Refuge without overhead screen
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person seeks house, elevated ground, or walled shelter, yet remains exposed directly to the sky.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: uncovered exposure to heaven `quranic:root_000994:B004/m01`; converging into shelter `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`; clinging low to the ground `quranic:root_000025:B006/m01`; flood-safe elevation `quranic:root_001476:B004/m01`; elevated cloud or ground `quranic:root_001675:B016/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Refuge ranges from crouching at ground level to entering a wall and climbing above flood. The uncovered-to-sky motif defeats the whole vertical spectrum: neither low attachment nor high escape restores a protective interval.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişi için acıma, iç yumuşaması, üzülme ve esirgeme duygusunu açıkça bu dalın merkezi yapar. Aynı ifade birinden bu acımayı istemeyi de verir; barınak, yere katılma ve bir şeyi toplama anlamları bu daldan ayrıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi için acıyıp içinin yumuşaması, ona karşı esirgeyici ve üzülmüş bir yöneliş taşımasıdır. Birinden böyle bir acıma isteme kullanımı bu duygu yönelişinin istek biçimidir.

facets.statement: Kişiye karşı acıma, iç yumuşaması ve üzülme duygusu dalın çekirdeğidir.
Duygu, belirli bir kişiye yönelir; genel barınma ya da toplanma ilişkisi değildir.
Birinden acımasını isteme kullanımı, aynı duygu yönelişinin talep biçimidir.
